goal: Apply for a loan with amount '1000' and down payment '10'. Select an account from the dropdown using select_option even if only one option exists, click Apply Now, and wait for 'Loan Request Processed' to appear. When calling done, include 'loan_status' and, if approved, 'new_account_id'. When you read 'new_account_id', always pass element_name set to 'Your new account number:' in the read tool call, so the value can be resolved to a stable element for later replay.
